div.div: بِئْرٌ (T, S, M, &c.) and بِيرٌ, (Msb,) of the fem. gender, (S, M, Msb, K,) and ↓ بِئْرَةٌ , (M,) A well: (M, TA:) pl. (of pauc., S, Msb) أَبْؤُرٌ (S, M, Msb, K) and (by transposition, Fr, Msb) آبُرٌ (Fr, Msb, K) and أَبْآرٌ and (by transposition, Yaakoob, T, S, M) آبَارٌ and (of mult., S, Msb) بِئَارٌ; (T, S, M, Msb, K;) and pl. of pauc. [of بِيرٌ] أَبْيَارٌ. (Msb.) The dim. is ↓ بُؤَيْرَةٌ . (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
